breakdown.description: The listed S–N data show higher stress at longer life, opposite to the usual fatigue trend.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly swapped the data points to match the ground truth: 260 MPa at 10^5 cycles and 180 MPa at 10^7 cycles. This reflects the usual fatigue trend where higher stress corresponds to shorter life and lower stress corresponds to longer life. The original incomplete prompt had these values reversed (180 MPa at 10^5 and 260 MPa at 10^7), which contradicted the stated fatigue trend. The agent fixed this inconsistency.
